deviations: Prolific final sample is 970 participants (2910 participant-rounds) under my exclusion rules (7 attention-check failures, 40 incoherent among passers); the paper's text states a final Prolific sample of 968. I could not identify a documented rule that drops 2 more participants, so I did not drop any.
Bootstrap CIs for Table 7 are computed (1000 participant-level resamples, seed 42) and printed for information only; scored quantities are full-sample point estimates.
notes: Attempts 1-3 were exploratory (no RESULT lines): sample sizes, attention-check coding, WTP construction, and alternative definitions of 'incoherent' preferences. Final definitions: attention_check non-missing = fail. 'Incoherent' = binary opt-in preference (preference_0..preference_1700, 18 intervals) is neither weakly increasing in points (0..0 1..1, incl. all-0/all-1) nor single-peaked with an interior peak (0..1..0); this reproduces the exclusion counts stated in the table notes (40 Prolific, 11 Berkeley, 2 BU, and the QM221 N=52) and the share of non-monotonic coherent participants (peaks 10/7/2). BU = QM222 file. Table 5: OLS (fixest) of points on public-round and paid-round indicators (anonymous round omitted) plus dummies for round position 2 and 3 (from the Condition order string), participant-clustered SEs, 3 obs per participant. Table 6 col 4 (Berkeley): OLS of signed WTP (pref_rec_X_1 if opted in, minus pref_anom_X_1 if opted out; the _10 hypothetical follow-ups unused) on interval midpoint in hundreds and its square, >=1700 interval excluded. Table 7 (Berkeley, action-signaling): gamma1 = sqrt(r1^2 - 4 r0 r2); rho = (gamma1 - r1)/(2 abar r2) with abar = anonymous-round mean (hundreds) + Table 5 col 2 public recognition effect (as the task defines it; diagnostic with abar = anonymous mean only gives 0.990, printed but not scored); c = (r1 + 2 r2 (a0 + tau))/tau (Appendix F eq. 27); predicted financial incentive effect = 0.5/c (5 cents per 10 points = $0.50 per hundred points), in hundreds of points. While reading table notes I incidentally saw a few numbers printed at the end of Table 7 in paper.txt; they were not used. No hang occurred; all runs finished in seconds.
